maintenance_led.reason: Mostly sells new fluid-handling equipment (paint sprayers, pumps, dispensing systems) to contractors, industry and consumers; aftermarket parts are a smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private contractors, manufacturers, vehicle service shops and DIY consumers buying sprayers and pumps, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through new products, new markets and geographic expansion; acquisitions (e.g., White Knight, ETM) are occasional strategic additions.

mission_critical.reason: Dispensing and mixing equipment is built into customers' manufacturing lines; switching means requalification, retraining and downtime.

notes: Mix of contractor, industrial and process segments; the answers rest on my recall of Graco as mainly a new-equipment maker.
